boundary.appDescription: Your work is still in memory but the interface could not recover on its own. Copy the details below before reloading — they tell a developer exactly what went wrong.
boundary.appTitle: Ori Studio ran into a problem
boundary.description: The rest of Ori Studio is still running. Try again, or copy the details and report it.

cp.foldProducedNothing: These creases have no flat folded form to draw

cpDetectImport.addFailed: The detected crease pattern could not be added.
cpDetectImport.unsupportedImage: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.

creasePattern.imageNotDecodable: Ori Studio could not read {{name}} as an image. Try a PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

fileDrop.dialogOpen: Finish the open dialog before dropping a file.
fileDrop.imageNotHere: Drop {{name}} onto the crease pattern to add it as a reference image.
fileDrop.unsupportedFile: Ori Studio cannot open {{name}}. Supported files: {{extensions}}.

fold.contradiction: This crease pattern isn't flat-foldable: some faces have no consistent stacking order.
fold.disconnected: This selection falls into separate pieces that don't touch, so it can't be folded as one model. Select one piece and fold again.
fold.foldedForm: This FOLD file holds a folded model rather than a crease pattern, so there are no creases to open. Open the crease pattern it was folded from instead.
fold.foldedFormTooLarge: This folded figure is too large to write into a FOLD file. Export the crease pattern on its own, or save the project as .osf, which keeps the figure.
fold.interiorCut: This crease pattern can't be folded: an edge line runs through the middle of the paper, with paper on both sides of it. Remove it, or make it a crease.
fold.isFlat: These creases are all full mountain and valley folds, so they fold flat rather than into a 3D shape.
fold.layerSearch: This crease pattern couldn't be folded: its layers can't be arranged without overlap.
fold.needs3d: Some of these creases fold to an angle other than a full mountain or valley, so they have no flat folded form. Try folding again — if it keeps happening, the app and the crease pattern have got out of step.
fold.sameParity: This crease pattern can't be folded flat: two faces meet with the same orientation across a crease.

global.title: Something went wrong in the background

projectFile.damaged: This Ori Studio project can't be read. It may be damaged, or saved by a version this app doesn't support.
projectFile.tooNew: This project was saved by a newer version of Ori Studio. Update Ori Studio, then open it again.
projectFile.unrecognized: This file isn't an Ori Studio project.

shareLink.invalid: That share link is incomplete or damaged — it was probably cut short when it was copied. Ask for it again.
shareLink.notFound: Couldn't open this share link. If it was just created, try again in a moment.
shareLink.rateLimited: Too many share links from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
shareLink.storageFailure: Couldn't create a share link. Check your connection and try again.
shareLink.storageQuota: Sharing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
shareLink.tooLarge: This crease pattern is too large to share as a link. Export it as a file instead.
shareLink.tooNew: That share link was made with a newer version of Ori Studio. Reload to get the latest version, then open it again.

worker.cpDetect: Crease-pattern detection stopped unexpectedly. Try importing the image again.
worker.oristudioBp: The box-pleating engine stopped unexpectedly. Reload Ori Studio to continue working on this design.
worker.oristudioCp: The crease-pattern engine stopped unexpectedly. Reload Ori Studio — unsaved edits since the last save may be lost.
worker.simulator: The simulator stopped unexpectedly. Reopen the Simulate workspace to restart it.
worker.treemaker: The design engine stopped unexpectedly. Reload Ori Studio to continue working on this tree.
